component.name: Secure Tunnel
component.summary: WireGuard and AmneziaWG client that can disguise its traffic

description.p: Secure Tunnel connects to WireGuard and AmneziaWG servers. It can make the start of a connection look like QUIC, DNS, SIP or STUN traffic, which helps on networks that use deep packet inspection to block VPNs.
It also has a kill switch, per-app routing and a SOCKS5 proxy option. You need a profile from your own server or provider.
